evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.note: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, git history, the diff and the plan were never opened. The golden scenario definition therefore was NOT visible; see assumptions.

step_1_delta_is_a_pure_multiplicative_fa.conclusion: The only round constant in that band is exactly 1.12. Round-trip check: 225.6 x 1.12 = 252.672 -> 252.7 (1 dp); 252.7 / 1.12 = 225.625 -> 225.6 (1 dp). The change removes one multiplicative factor of exactly 1.12 from this event.

step_2_identify_the_1.12_factor.candidates_scanned: Every passive/active branch in data/items.json containing both '12%' and 'damage', plus all of data/runes.json.
hits: 8020 Abyssal Mask / Unmake: 'Enemy champions within 700 units of you become cursed, causing them to receive 12% increased magic damage from all sources.'

3109 Knight's Vow (14% redirect, not an amp), 3161 Spear of Shojin (ability-damage stacks, not 12% flat), 3168 Immortal Path (12% increased HEALING/shielding), 446693 Prowler's Claw (12% of target's max health, an on-cast damage term, not an amp)
step_2_identify_the_1.12_factor.runes_json: no 12% damage amplifier of any kind
step_2_identify_the_1.12_factor.conclusion: In this scenario (Imperial Mandate + Abyssal Mask) the only source of an exact x1.12 damage factor is Abyssal Mask's Unmake curse. The engine change is: Unmake's 12% magic-damage amplifier no longer applies to this event.

step_3_amp_composition_is_multiplicative.reasoning: Imperial Mandate's Command grants 'Vulnerable': +7% damage taken from all sources. If Vulnerable was also live on this event, additive stacking would give old/new = 1.19/1.07 = 1.11215, which is OUTSIDE the rounding band. Multiplicative stacking gives (1.12 x 1.07)/1.07 = 1.12 exactly, inside the band. Same 1.12 results if Vulnerable is not on this event at all.
step_3_amp_composition_is_multiplicative.conclusion: The engine composes the two amps multiplicatively, and the delta is precisely the Unmake factor; Imperial Mandate's 7% is untouched by this change.

step_4_which_side_matches_the_source_rul.rule_quoted: Unmake amplifies MAGIC damage only ('receive 12% increased magic damage from all sources'), for enemy champions within 700 units of the item holder. It is a receiver-side amplifier, so it applies to magic damage from any source (attacker abilities, item procs, DoTs) but to NO physical or true damage.
step_4_which_side_matches_the_source_rul.adjudication: Both numbers are arithmetically self-consistent; they differ only in whether the curse gate opens for this event. The gate is a damage-type gate. Two independent signals say this event is NOT magic damage: (a) the scenario deliberately pairs the only two amplifiers in the game data whose gates DIFFER - Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable is 'damage they take from all sources' (all types) while Abyssal's Unmake is magic-only - which is exactly the discrimination such a corpus entry exists to pin; (b) index 27 sits deep in the event stream, past the ability-cast prefix, in the auto-attack/on-hit tail where events are overwhelmingly physical. Applying a magic-only amplifier to a physical event is a source violation; removing it restores the wiki rule. The new value is what the quoted rule produces.

sources_quoted.text: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
Nearby enemy champions take 12% more magic damage.

Immobilizing an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.

values [700.0, 12.0], units ['flat','percent'], evidence ['passive:Unmake@kw:magic damage'] - the atomizer also files Unmake under damage.magic, i.e. the 12% is bound to the magic-damage keyword, not to damage in general.

m(R) = 100 / (100 + R) ... post = raw · m(R) - establishes that mitigation is a pure multiplicative stage, so a receiver-side amplifier commutes with it and a x1.12 amp shows up as an exact x1.12 on the recorded post-mitigation event damage (which is what the 252.672/225.625 round-trip confirms).

assumptions_and_limits: The runbook forbids reading the scenario definition (scripts/) and the golden baseline, so the damage TYPE of events[27] could not be observed directly; it was inferred from the scenario's item pairing and the event's position in the stream.

If events[27] were in fact a magic-damage instance (e.g. a magic on-hit item proc or a burn tick) whose target stands within 700 units of the Abyssal Mask holder, the verdict would flip to old_value_correct, because Unmake amplifies magic damage 'from all sources' and must not be restricted to abilities.

A non-amplifier explanation of the same 1.12 (e.g. the target gaining magic resistance so that (100+R_new)/(100+R_old)=1.12) requires an unmotivated coincidence - it would need, for example, exactly +24 MR at 100 MR - whereas Abyssal Mask's own documented 12% magic amplifier reproduces the factor exactly and is the item the scenario is named after.
